[[Vera]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Jayne Forestlight]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30
